You first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, when you posted that the gate kiosks were down at the Hartford plant with both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan.

The channel records only one thing the guard was doing in the meantime: writing trailer numbers on a clipboard (your 10:42 message). Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03 AM, and Mateo then reported that the guard checked in trailer 8836. You posted at 11:08 AM that both lanes were working as of 11:07. Nothing else about the guard's actions between 10:42 and 11:03 appears in the channel.
